snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader – The Infinite Museion Release Date Trailer | Warhammer Skulls 2026
snippet.description:
The Infinite Museion, the third story expansion for Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader, draws you into the iconic vault of Trazyn the Infinite and will be released on June 11, 2026. Pursue rare artefacts, enhance yourself with augmentations, and choose whether to serve the designs of one of the galaxy’s most infamous collectors or oppose him.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4226770/Warhammer_40000_Rogue_Trader__The_Infinite_Museion/
https://store.epicgames.com/p/warhammer-40000-rogue-trader-warhammer-40000-rogue-trader-the-infinite-museion-eac312?lang=nl
https://www.gog.com/en/game/warhammer_40000_rogue_trader_the_infinite_museion

See all the Skulls 2026 reveals on Warhammer Community: https://www.warhammer-community.com/en-gb/articles/2eknkrto/skulls-2026-the-warhammer-video-games-festival/
